Salon Commission Pay Kit
Galaxy Forge Implementation Kit v1.0 (September 2026)

FILES
- salon_commission_pay_kit_guide.pdf : main implementation guide
- salon_commission_pay_kit_workbook.xlsx : Excel workbook (4 sheets)
- salon_stylist_payout_statement.docx : editable template

- salon_commission_agreement_template.docx : editable template

HOW TO USE: start with Quick Start (section 2 of the guide), then work the 14-day plan in section 9.
SUPPORT: email support for file/usage questions within 7 days of purchase.
